explication: This repository is a multilingual Bash-scripting guide and ebook, with an accompanying promotional webpage. Readers progress from foundational Bash concepts to practical automation examples; the English chapter list documents both stages, while parallel language directories provide translated editions. Ibis is the documented ebook tool, and per-language PHP files supply its book metadata. The README also describes downloadable PDF/ePub editions and a web page. Source excerpts are limited to Ibis configuration and small page JavaScript, so internal publishing links beyond documented relationships are not inferred.
